hero.title: Cross-border payments. Real-time settlement.
hero.text: Connect your institution to infrastructure for cross-border payments and foreign-exchange settlement. Softcom works with RTGS.global to support implementation for financial institutions in Nigeria and across Africa.

blocks.title: Connect the payment. Complete the settlement.
blocks.text: RTGS.global provides a real-time gross settlement network for financial institutions. It supports linked settlement across two currencies and cross-border customer payments through participating Funds Controllers.

points.title: Settle foreign exchange
points.text: Link the two sides of an agreed FX trade for payment-versus-payment settlement. Matching instructions and sufficient funds allow the network to complete the exchange and confirm the result.

points.title: Deliver cross-border payments
points.text: Initiate payments to overseas beneficiaries through Funds Controllers on the network. Onward delivery is handled by the relevant Funds Controller.

points.title: Keep operations informed
points.text: Bring payment-status notifications, transaction information and network balances into your institution’s workflows through API integration.

blocks.title: From agreed trade to confirmed settlement.
blocks.text: Counterparties agree a trade, submit their instructions and receive confirmation when settlement completes. The connection brings the settlement process into the institution’s existing operations.

image.alt: Three-step flow from agreeing a trade to linking instructions and confirming settlement

blocks.title: Global infrastructure. Local implementation.
blocks.text: RTGS.global provides the network. Softcom works with your institution and the platform team to connect it to the systems, processes and operating requirements that make it usable locally.

points.title: Define the requirement
points.text: Establish the payment or settlement use case, intended counterparties and the institutional systems involved.

points.title: Integrate and validate
points.text: Connect the relevant workflows and support testing through the platform’s integration environments.

points.title: Prepare for operation
points.text: Coordinate implementation around onboarding, operating responsibilities and the requirements of the institution and its network partners.

audience.title: For institutions moving value across borders.
audience.text: For banks and other eligible regulated financial institutions seeking to develop cross-border payment and settlement capabilities. Available currencies, corridors and services depend on network participation, counterparties and applicable requirements.
audience.closing: Tell us where you need to move value and how your institution operates today.
